item.title: Dembele sends PSG past wounded Liverpool into Champions League semis
item.summary: Ousmane Dembele's double guided Paris Saint-Germain into the Champions League semi-finals as a 2-0 win over Liverpool at Anfield on Tuesday completed a 4-0 aggregate win for the holders.

item.title: Pope heads to Cameroon with message of peace for conflict zone
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV left Algeria on Wednesday headed for Cameroon for a four-day trip that includes a visit to the epicentre of a nearly decade-long separatist conflict, where he is due to bring a message of peace. FRANCE 24's Indira Ayuk reports from Yaoundé, Cameroon.
